text: Free demo: it's the Backrooms, except the architect had no idea what they were doing.
Same yellow wallpaper, same humming lights, same feeling that you shouldn't be here.
Then you walk into a white tiled room where a single toilet sits on a podium, facing a stadium full of seats.
Best bits: a skeleton stuck halfway through a wall, and a giant rubber duck in an indoor pool.
The catch? The rooms look photorealistic, but the characters move like looping props.
The demo is under nine hundred megabytes, with voice acting in eleven languages.
Think Escape the Backrooms, rewritten by the Stanley Parable narrator.
Worth a dip if liminal spaces make you laugh instead of scared.
